editorial:
Ever wondered why the TV version of Jon Snow feels so different from the one in the books? You are in for a wild ride with this documentary. It takes a deep dive into everything that makes Aegon Targaryen III who he is, while poking fun at the choices the showrunners made. The vibe is super laid-back and funny, feeling more like a long hangout with a friend who is obsessed with lore than a boring classroom lecture. It really breaks down the character arcs in a way that makes you look at the whole story in a new light.

What really stands out is how the director keeps things moving despite the massive length. The humor is spot on, and the comparisons are clear and easy to follow. The only downside is that it is way too long for one sitting, so you will need to take breaks. If you love the world of Westeros, you should definitely grab this.
endingExplained: The film wraps up by showing that the TV version of Jon Snow lost much of the depth found in the books. The final twist is a funny realization that the show basically turned a complex leader into a guy who just says he knows nothing. It concludes that while both versions are great, the book version is the real deal. You end the movie feeling like you finally understand the gap between the page and the screen.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Game of Thrones and deep lore dives.
